name: Calendar
description: Calendars of events with time zones, repeats and alerts, shared with people, in and out as .ics.

actions.name: calendar.list_calendars
actions.description: My calendars and the ones shared with me (with the number of events in each). Colors: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple, pink, brown, gray.

actions.name: calendar.update_calendar
actions.description: Rename a calendar, change its color, or show or hide it on this device (shown). The calendar is an id or a name.

actions.name: calendar.delete_calendar
actions.description: Delete a calendar with all its events from every device (for the owner), or leave a calendar someone shared with you.

actions.name: calendar.agenda
actions.description: The occurrences between from and to (dates or times; default today and the next 7 days), seen in zone (IANA name, default this device's), from the shown calendars or the ones named.

actions.name: calendar.get
actions.description: One event (id, or id@occurrence for one occurrence of a repeating event).

actions.name: calendar.add
actions.description: Add an event. start is 2026-11-24T10:00 (wall time in zone), an RFC 3339 time, or 2026-11-24 for all day; end defaults to an hour (a day) later and is exclusive for all-day events. repeat: daily, weekdays, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly or an RRULE. alerts: minutes before the start.

actions.name: calendar.update
actions.description: Change an event. For a repeating event pass the occurrence (id@occurrence, or at) and span: this (default with an occurrence), following, or all. Empty repeat stops repeating.

actions.name: calendar.move
actions.description: Move an event to a new start (keeping its length) and/or to another calendar (whole events only).

actions.name: calendar.delete
actions.description: Delete an event from every device; for a repeating event with an occurrence, span this (default), following or all.

actions.name: calendar.search
actions.description: Find events by words in the title, location or notes (all words must match).

actions.name: calendar.invite
actions.description: Invite people (ids or names of contacts) to an event in a calendar you own, or take the invitation back (remove).

actions.name: calendar.invitations
actions.description: Events people invited me to, with my answers.

actions.name: calendar.respond
actions.description: Answer an invitation: accepted, declined or tentative.

actions.name: calendar.share
actions.description: Share a calendar you own with a person (id or name) as read or write, or stop sharing (mode none).

actions.name: calendar.export
actions.description: A calendar, or every calendar (none named), as iCalendar (.ics) text.

actions.name: calendar.import
actions.description: Add the events of an .ics file to a calendar (calendar), to one named after the file (name), or, for a Sol export of every calendar, to the calendars it names. Events are matched by UID, so importing a file twice changes nothing.

actions.name: calendar.subscription
actions.description: Read-only .ics files (one per calendar, plus all.ics) kept current on this device, with their paths and file:// URLs, for a desktop calendar app (Thunderbird, GNOME Calendar, Evolution) to subscribe to.

actions.name: calendar.snapshot
actions.description: Everything the UI shows in one call: calendars, invitations and the occurrences between from and to in zone.
